description.en: The billing cycle in the YYYY-MM format.

description.zh: 账单日期，仅当**Granularity**为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD。
description.en: The billing date. This parameter is required only when **Granularity** is set to DAILY. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

description.zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值如下：

- MONTHLY：月。与费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-账期账单一致。
- DAILY：日。与费用中心-费用账单-账单明细-按天账单一致。

> 选择DAILY需指定BillingDate。
description.en:
The granularity at which you want to query bills. Valid values:

- MONTHLY: by month. The bill details are consistent with the bills on the By Billing Cycle tab of the Bill Details page in User Center.

- DAILY: by day. The bill details are consistent with the bills on the By Day tab of the Bill Details page in User Center.

> If you set this parameter to DAILY, you must specify BillingDate.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页行数。其中最大值为100行，默认值为20行。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 如果**NextToken**为空表示没有下一次查询。
- 如果**NextToken**有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌。
description.en:
The token that is used to start the next query. Valid values:

- If **NextToken** is empty, no more results exist.

- If **NextToken** has a value, the value is the token that is used to start the next query.

description.zh:
服务实例ID。

您可以通过调用[ListServiceInstances - 查询服务实例列表](~~396200~~)获取服务实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the service instance.

You can call the [ListServiceInstances](~~396200~~) operation to obtain the service instance ID.

title.en: Query the bill for the service instance

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-service-instance-bill --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAfu+XtuBE55iRLHEYYuojI4= --service-instance-id si-0d0d7bc9accc4e2e8a8f --billing-cycle 2025-03 --granularity MONTHLY --billing-date 2024-12-05 --service-id service-6121296da4f44e469519 --service-version 1 --region cn-hangzhou
